sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Collect Like Items are straightforward. Players are presented with a grid of items, and their goal is to create groups of three or more items of the same type to clear them from the board. The game uses a variety of items, including stars, hearts, and diamonds, each with its own unique properties and points values. Players can move items around the board by clicking on them and swapping them with adjacent items. When a group of three or more items of the same type is created, they are cleared from the board, and points are awarded.

The game also features a "charged item" system. When a player creates a group of five identical items, a charged item is created, which will clear all the items around it. This adds a new layer of strategy to the game, as players must carefully plan their moves to create charged items and clear the board efficiently. Additionally, the game features "power-ups" that can be used to clear the board or create charged items. These power-ups can be obtained by clearing groups of items or by using in-game currency.

Overall, the core gameplay mechanics of Collect Like Items are engaging and challenging, and the game's unique twist on the classic match-three formula makes it stand out from other puzzle games in this genre.
